author: bviveka
hypothesis: Reproduce CWM reference pipeline end-to-end on KuaiRand-Pure before any task-specific modifications, to establish a working mechanical baseline.
code_diff: train_model2.py: gated 2 unconditional .cuda() calls in _test_and_save() behind self.use_cuda; added missing use_cuda=self.use_cuda kwarg to 3 Wrap_Dataset2(...) calls in _wrap_dat()
command: python3 main.py --dat_name KuaiRand --model_name FM --label_name CWM --fout ./test_run --use_cuda False

metrics.note: CWM's native metrics only — NOT NDCG@10/Recall@50, which this pipeline doesn't compute yet

errors_and_recovery: ModuleNotFoundError: torch — resolved by activating conda env cwm instead of system python3
requirements.txt pinned torch==2.13.0+cu126 (CUDA build) — incompatible with Mac; stripped CUDA suffix
FileNotFoundError on prepare_data.py output — output dir rec_datasets/WM_KuaiRand/ didn't exist, created it
AssertionError: Torch not compiled with CUDA enabled, in _test_and_save() — .cuda() called unconditionally, patched to respect use_cuda flag
Same error again in _wrap_dat() — Wrap_Dataset2 calls weren't forwarding use_cuda, defaulted to True regardless of CLI flag; added missing kwarg
notes: This run uses CWM's native --label_name CWM, which trains on watch-time (play_time_truncate), not click. Confirmed by code review that pre_kuairand.py drops is_click entirely. Task requires click=positive; this is a known gap, not yet resolved — see iteration 2 for click-label addition.
